title: Ledger-Eye Clerk
text: Ledger-Eye Clerk counts possessions through a brass lens and flags anything whose owner looks uncertain. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Doubt is sufficient proof of arrears.

defeatReward.text: Ledger-Eye Clerk is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
